name: harley-repo-ops
description: Self-contained Harley repo-ops bundle with shared House Skills for cross-repo worker safety and dispatch.
rights: First-party Harley-authored source packaged as a self-contained repo-ops bundle. The skills under this bundle are repo-held copies of first-party House Skills and remain documented by source path in SOURCE.md and references/source-map.md.

interface.shortDescription: Shared repo-ops guidance for Codex workers across Harley repos
interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin bundle that packages the shared House Skills needed for safe cross-repo worker dispatch, Linear control-plane work, and connector-safe side effects.
defaultPrompt: Use the Harley Repo Ops Bundle to inspect live repo state before making changes.
Use connector-safety for any side-effecting connector or tool action.
Use worker-dispatch-linear and Linear guidance for routing, gating, and proof surfaces.
Report include/exclude decisions and publish proof before claiming completion.
